inclusionPolicy: All five official LoL wagers are included. Wagers 3 and 4 are explicit user-directed probation exceptions; their execution deviations remain preserved. Wager 5 was fully model-compliant.

strictModelApprovedExecutionView.note: This view is retained for clean model attribution. It does not override the user's instruction to count all official wagers in the main probation view.

wagers.event: Anyone's Legend vs ThunderTalk Gaming — Game 1
wagers.primaryError: Early neutrality and nominal waveclear were incorrectly treated as demonstrated stall evidence; stronger-team and structure-acceleration risk was underpriced.

wagers.event: Anyone's Legend vs ThunderTalk Gaming — Game 2
wagers.primaryCaution: The wager won narrowly at 28 kills; the result supports the clean-close branch but does not validate the original probability range by itself.

wagers.event: Top Esports vs LGD Gaming — Game 3
wagers.primaryError: Temporary recovery and low tower progression were treated as durable resistance without proving that LGD could survive the next major objective-loss branch.
wagers.executionDeviation: Immediate same-state odds move from 1.827 to 2.117 exceeded both material reassessment thresholds.

wagers.primaryError: An official duration over was issued without completing the existing required duration block or establishing a conservative earliest finish safely beyond the line.
wagers.executionDeviation: Odds moved by 0.101 and stake exceeded the 0.25u map cap by 0.05u.

wagers.event: Karmine Corp vs Natus Vincere — Game 1
wagers.entryState: At 10:46 NAVI led 2-0 in kills, approximately 0.6k gold and 3-0 in Void Grubs, with towers and dragons 0-0.
wagers.primaryError: The model treated a modest early kill/economy lead plus Void Grubs as sufficient moneyline confirmation without adequately pricing KC's player-strength and lead-conversion advantage.
wagers.userAssessment: NAVI threw the game; player difference decided the result.

reviewConclusion.primaryModelIssue: Duration-over promotion from correlated quiet-state evidence remains the largest historical issue; the latest loss also exposed overconfidence in an underdog moneyline from low-commitment early confirmations.
reviewConclusion.primaryProcedureIssue: Required duration and post-15 item-strength evidence must be captured without delaying early live verdicts. Underdog moneylines now require hard conversion evidence and a lead-conversion reliability check.
reviewConclusion.primaryExecutionIssue: Two wagers crossed material price thresholds and one exceeded the map stake cap; wager 5 was execution-compliant.
actions: Activated lol-v0.3.13 with a same-day duration-over suspension, complete synchronized-state requirement, two durable anti-conversion events, fastest-finish-path inventory, three-minute finish-window margin, and one-fight compression veto.
Activated lol-v0.3.14 with item inventory, usable-strength classification, damage-versus-durability comparison, unknown-item veto, and item-completion expiry triggers.
Activated lol-v0.3.15: item snapshots are optional before 15:00 and mandatory at or after 15:00 when decision-critical.
Activated lol-v0.3.16: draft evaluation now scores damage delivery, carry protection, execution burden and single-point-of-failure risk.

Activated lol-v0.3.17: underdog live moneylines require at least one hard conversion confirmation, explicit next-two-sequence analysis, favorite comeback pricing, and team/player lead-conversion reliability checks. Kills plus small gold plus Void Grubs cannot complete the official gate.
